Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 
SPECIFICATION FOR JIG FOOT NUTS 



( Reaffirmed 2001 



1. Scope — Covers dimensions and other requirements for jig foot nuts used with jig foot bolts 
according to IS : 11831-1986 'Specification for jig foot boitj'.

3. Threads — Shall be 6H class as per IS : 4218 'ISO metric screw threads'. 

4. Material -- Steel having tensile strength of 370 IVlPa, MIn. 

4.1 The chamfered face of diameter du if agreed to between the manufacturer and the user, shall be 
hardened to 550 HV, Min, 

5. Designation — A jig foot nut having dj^ » 25 mm and /i ^ 50 mm shall be designated as: 

Jig foot nut 25 x 50 IS : 1 1843 

6. Finish — The jig foot nuts shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other defects. 

7. Preservation and Packing 

7.1 A suitable anti-corrosive surface treatment shall be given to jig foot nuts. 

7.2 Jig Foot nuts shall be packed in suitable cartons so as to prevent damage during transit. 

8. Marking — The cartons containing the jig foot nuts shall be marked with designation and 
manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 

8.1 CertificatiGn Marking— Details available with Bureau of Indian Standards.
